criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Dark-field renders with a warm pool; slides 1 and 4 work. The SDF dog reads as a toy, worst on 9; slide 2's phone reads as a kiosk; slide 3's dog about 60 px in a mid-tone band; slide 5 primitives with 23px labels under the 24px floor; slide 8 one bar with a dead lower band. Reliefs carry measured height and casts; slide 7's rule has 7 divisions.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One grade and one key, the box motif changes state and retires, one dog; 6 to 8 from another stock, 6 and 7 two grids back to back.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every fact traces to primaries, quotes verbatim, numerals traced, the 2019 absence stated. Slide 3's 'on each clip' where c4 and c5 check each animal; 'will survey' though field work is under way per c10; the contractor's release carries most of the load.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where are clear; areas unnamed, no decision record, no use of the label, nothing to do; the appearance stake shown once.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover stops a thumb; 2 restates the cover, 3 and 5 list the same checks, 6 and 7 both say 32 areas; the close does not land.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean plain hooks; body leans on 'The release says'; little regional texture; flat passive caption opener.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: First animal hero and a lens-view cover; the lastLight dark field again and the counted-units relief again.

ranked_defects.fix: Close on the caption's question against the report going to ACS.

ranked_defects.defect: Repeats slide 3's checks; 23px labels under the 24px floor.
ranked_defects.fix: Cut the list or use the frame for human review overruling the machine.

ranked_defects.defect: A second grid of 32 squares after slide 6.
The phone reads as a kiosk.
ranked_defects.fix: Reframe from inside the cabin with the glass edge and seal.

ranked_defects.defect: 'will survey' for field work already running.
The strongest beat is never developed.
ranked_defects.fix: Say what the classification decides, or that the release doesn't say.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Kiosk on a pedestal, no glass or door for scale.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera inside the cabin behind the phone, glass edge and seal framing it.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Toy-like dog, dead lower concrete, spike grass.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop the empty concrete, fur normal and rim, parkway straw.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Small dog in a mid-tone band; labels on busy fence.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Eye to about 2 m, tighter fov, ground outside the pool to near black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: One bar with a dead lower 40 percent.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rule to the middle, block two thirds of the width, week graduations.
Push in, rows at 26px or larger.
